about: The Children's Museum of Green Bay hosts Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 12, 2026, at Mackinaws, 2925 Voyager Dr.
Families pick one of two time slots, 8 to 9 AM or 9 to 10 AM. Tickets are $30 per person, and children 10 months and younger are free.
The morning includes breakfast, a visit with Santa, holiday STEAM activities, sweet treats and festive surprises, and ticket sales support the museum.
